name: Prediction block names a winner or a draw
description: When a visitor opens a match permalink, the prediction block names a predicted winner that is one of the two teams or a draw outcome for group-stage matches.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id and the two team names from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Verify the prediction block names a winner that is one of the match's two teams (or a draw label for a group-stage fixture), matching the team names returned by the API
